purpose: Two-mesh sensitivity of nitrogen replacement at nine wafer-adjacent positions.
unchanged: physical properties and total inlet flow
primary_metric: First time all nine cell-sampled label fractions reach 0.90, linearly interpolated between the two bracketing diagnostic times; verify they remain above threshold thereafter.
secondary_metric: Maximum absolute difference between paired probe histories over their common simulated interval.
required_checks: flow settling, balance, outward-only outlets, low Mach
tracer bounds and conservative label budget
limits: Two meshes cannot establish asymptotic convergence or a formal grid convergence index.
Cell sampling can shift to different cell centres even at fixed physical probe positions.
Nine samples do not establish full-wafer uniformity or deposition.
Early half-time-step result covers 20 s only; t90 temporal sensitivity must be checked separately.
